name: @freeside/eligibility-protocol
description: Sealed EligibilityRule noun + EligibilityVerdict for the Freeside order/access system. Reconciles the three legacy EligibilityRule shapes (coexistence/chain/worker) into one published-language Zod schema. Product-agnostic: never imports a product's own schema (e.g. shadow-audit) — EVANS bounded-context boundary.
